scenes.title: 몸과 보드에서 비행기로 넓혀 보기
lines: We will also use an aircraft's body and wings to separate intermediate orientation from how quickly time advances.

scenes.title: 비행기에서 중간 자세를 관찰하기
lines: Look at the aircraft. Red marks its body direction; blue marks its wings.
As the craft banks, both directions change. There are intermediate orientations between its earlier and later poses.
The camera moves too, so screen inclination is not a measured game-world angle.
This does not reveal the game's interpolation algorithm. We choose explicit starting and target orientations in the next model.

scenes.title: 정한 두 자세의 절반을 실제로 만들기
lines: Our model starts at zero degrees and targets a ninety-degree rotation about z. At half the time parameter, SLERP gives forty-five degrees.
The quaternion stores the half angle, twenty-two point five degrees. Halving all four components is a different operation.
Rotate the body and wing directions together. Their lengths and perpendicular relationship remain unchanged.

scenes.title: 같은 경로라도 시간 사용은 다를 수 있습니다
lines: Compare the same aircraft model with fixed endpoints. A linear time parameter gives forty-five degrees at half time.
Squaring that parameter changes one half to one quarter, giving twenty-two point five degrees. The orientation path and endpoints stay the same, but progress along the path changes.

scenes.title: 비행기에서도 같은 자세를 바꿔 적기
lines: We will transfer the direction checks from cars and boards to an aircraft's body and wings, and verify the same orientation.

scenes.title: 몸통 하나만으로 전체 자세를 알 수 있을까요
lines: Now compare an aircraft instead of a car. Follow the red body direction and blue wing direction together.
A similar forward direction can coexist with different wing inclinations. Matching one direction does not prove a matching complete orientation.
We hide the lines when camera changes make them unreliable. A screen image does not reveal nine engine matrix values.
Next we rotate explicitly defined model axes and compare the quaternion and matrix results.

scenes.title: 행렬의 열은 돌린 기준축입니다
lines: Rotate the model ninety degrees about z. Its forward x direction becomes y; its wing y direction becomes minus x.
The upward z direction is unchanged. Those three results form the first, second and third matrix columns.
The same quaternion must rotate all three vectors to those same results. Changing representation does not add another rotation to the craft.

scenes.title: 세 직각 화살표라도 반사가 섞일 수 있습니다
lines: Three unit-length, perpendicular axes are orthonormal. But reversing only x while keeping y and z gives a reflection.
For this diagonal matrix, the determinant is minus one times one times one: minus one. A half-turn reverses two axes, whose diagonal product is plus one.
We therefore check the determinant as well as lengths and right angles. Quaternion normalization cannot turn a reflection into a valid rotation.
